package oracle

// Fixture copied into the fake tree's dirac/oracle by
// TestUnrefuseStaleKeepsLockstepCards. It is never compiled: scripts/testdata is
// ignored by the go tool. It only has the shape a real refusal-pinning test has,
// so the guard must read it as one.

import "testing"

// TestGuardLockedCardReprosLockstep pins a refusal entry: it names the card and
// fails when the entry is gone, so unrefuse-stale.sh must keep that entry.
func TestGuardLockedCardReprosLockstep(t *testing.T) {
	card := "Guard Locked Card"
	if card != "Guard Locked Card" {
		t.Fatal("Guard Locked Card has no dirac/support/refused entry")
	}
}

// TestGuardFreeCardNoLockstep names the free card but is not a ReprosLockstep
// test, so it does not pin the entry: unrefuse-stale.sh may unrefuse it.
func TestGuardFreeCardNoLockstep(t *testing.T) {
	if "Guard Free Card" == "" {
		t.Fatal("unreachable")
	}
}
